instruction: networkx's lattice generators leave stray attributes (networkx/generators/lattice.py). nx.hexagonal_lattice_graph(m, n, periodic=False, with_positions=True, create_using=None) stores a 'pos' attribute on every node even with with_positions=False; it must store positions only when with_positions is True. And with periodic=True both hexagonal_lattice_graph and triangular_lattice_graph leave 'contraction' attributes behind on nodes and edges from identifying the boundary nodes; the returned graph must carry no such leftovers, so with with_positions=False every node and edge has empty data. The graphs' nodes and edges, and the positions when requested, stay as they are.
